exposure: poor self-assessment of sleep status in late pregnancy
high score of Five Factors Inventory Neuroticism subscale
high Quality of Relationship Index score
cohort: The study recruited 602 pregnant women hospitalized for delivery in Qingdao Municipal Hospital and Jinzhou Maternal and Child Health Hospital in China between November 2022 and October 2023.
finding: Poor self-assessment of sleep status in late pregnancy, cesarean section, instrumental delivery, fear of labor, and a high score of Five Factors Inventory Neuroticism subscale were independent risk factors for postpartum PTSD, while a high Quality of Relationship Index score was a protective factor.
mod_finding: Cesarean section and instrumental delivery were identified as independent risk factors for developing postpartum PTSD.
